hardVisualRules: Every expanded widget preserves the same colour family as its collapsed/original widget.
Large reading surfaces stay premium graphite; semantic identity appears in borders, headings, icons, rails and restrained tints.
Search fields are neutral grey/silver.
Completed reservation/itinerary/checklist surfaces are silver/slate, not bright semantic colours.

Reservation Add opens from the sky Add Reservation source and stays sky while choosing booking type; Edit inherits the source booking/category state (for example Cruise violet, Completed silver, To Book copper) through nested and destructive flows.
Itinerary editor/detail family follows source/travel identity: Standard blue, Home Visit gold, Motorhome copper, Cruise violet; destination-row colours do not recolour editor/detail shells.
Budget Destination Budgets source, expanded manager and Add/Edit Destination Budget flow preserve the live source colour family; no stale teal/sky override may repaint the editor.

Calendar Add/Edit shells preserve the colour family of the source reminder/note surface; cross-screen handoffs retain the originating colour family and exact read-only details preserve destination/event identity.
Checklist and Vault Add/Edit/Delete flows preserve the colour family of the source card/category through expanded and nested editor states; no neutral fallback may override a supplied source tone.
Home Alerts use red/amber/green traffic-light severity; expanded Alerts remain concise and Remove-only.
All interactive controls on approved iPad layouts retain at least 44px effective touch targets.
Home 1024 compact Alerts and Trip Timeline dates must remain fully readable without making Home scroll.
Vault header must mask obsolete baked status text/count/date at both approved iPad widths.
Destination Budget manager summary values must not crop 22px currency glyphs.

Journey History summary-card icon tiles are the benchmark for Booked Reservations and The Vault category icons: category-specific colour, dark inset tile, stronger contrast, consistent size/padding/border/glow; Completed remains silver.
Calendar month days may display up to five dated items and the week row grows vertically before +more is used.
Annual Budget main card is display-only; year-by-year annual budget Set/Edit belongs only inside the expanded Annual Budget manager.
Add Expense and Add Reservation prioritise the entered amount and AUD equivalent over helper text; blanket green is not used as general decoration.

Journey History, Checklist, The Vault and Settings use their exact supplied baked header artwork in the approved per-screen header heights (214px, 214px, 188px, 166px respectively); the full artwork must remain visible with no centre crop, zoom, overscan or universal shared-height override.

Within any single visible viewport, top-level widgets/cards visible together must have clearly distinct colour identities; the same or near-same colour may be reused only when those widgets cannot be visible together.
App Health detail cards use distinct visual card identities while their status dots/labels remain semantic green/amber/red; expanded App Health cards preserve their source card identity.
Home is a fixed one-screen command centre: the normal main canvas must not document-scroll or drift; only intentionally expanded modal content may scroll internally.
The fixed sidebar is icon-only in both portrait/upright and landscape iPad modes to maximise usable content width; accessible screen names remain available through aria-labels.
Itinerary Upcoming and Completed rows stay predominantly dark/neutral with one restrained identity accent; normal budget amounts are white and only Budget Not Set/setup-required states use amber.
Journey History Completed Stays & Trips follows the same calm, high-contrast row language as Itinerary, with restrained travel-type accents rather than multiple competing coloured labels/values.
Booked Reservations and The Vault top category cards use Journey History-strength coloured card/icon identities while their large numeric counts remain white.
Home Trip Timeline expands only into the full forward read-only timeline; it does not offer nested itinerary editing/navigation from the Home widget.
Budget Accounts is a manual/offline snapshot with Add/Edit/Delete available from the enlarged Accounts manager; transfers and live bank connections remain out of scope.
Reservation Health Check is not shown on Reservations; whole-app App Health exists only in Settings.
Journey Check is absent from Journey History; all per-screen health/check panels are removed. App Health in Settings is the only app-wide check surface.
Calendar has no Sync Check panel; Agenda rows use one destination/travel colour marker only, with event kind conveyed by text/icon semantics.
Schengen Status exists only on Home. Settings must not duplicate a Schengen Status card or editor.
Expanded Lifetime Travel Spend uses a distinct category colour for each category bar instead of one outer-widget colour for every bar.
Journey milestones are automatic and information-rich enough to fill their card without a manual favourite-destination field.

Ready to Move uses explicit semantic hierarchy: overall not-ready red/coral, remaining work amber, completed/zero-overdue green, active-stage informational blue, plus a visible readiness progress summary.
Home orientation header shows the current destination and the separate next destination context together; route stops never replace the current destination banner.

Installed iPad native startup artwork must have an exact asset/media-query match for every physically supported iPad size, including 768×1024, 820×1180 and 834×1194 logical DPR2 devices in both orientations; the brand splash and following destination launch stage remain centered and visually continuous.

Launch branding and destination identity are deliberately prominent on iPad: the Travel Command Centre icon/wordmark and current flag/country/city must be substantially larger than the earlier small launch treatment and remain centred across all supported iPad orientations.
Ordinary taps and double-taps must never zoom the app canvas. Deliberate pinch/spread zoom remains available; interactive maps keep their dedicated pan/pinch gesture handling.

Add Reservation type selector icons and Add Expense category selector icons retain distinct semantic category colours even before selection; selection strengthens the same category identity rather than replacing it with white.
Native iPad/Safari date and time controls inside Add/Edit forms must remain constrained to their grid tracks and must never overlap adjacent fields, routing widgets, currency cards or action areas.

Nested Itinerary map placement opened from Destination, RV / Motorhome or Cruise must preserve the live editor colour family (blue, copper or violet) through the expanded map picker; it must never fall back to neutral.
All editable iPad form controls must render at 16px or larger so Safari focus never auto-zooms the app; ordinary tap/focus must not change page scale.

Tiny positive foreign-currency conversions must display the same canonical AUD cent value before Save as the value stored after Save; a positive amount may not display AUD 0.00 when canonical storage is AUD 0.01.
Shared icon hue families are numerically identical across Journey History, Booked Reservations and The Vault; Journey History is the RGB benchmark while category assignments remain unchanged.

Checklist stage navigation keeps the approved neutral/blue visual treatment. Fixes are limited to text size, icon lane, padding and containment so all four labels stay inside their tiles; Checklist Overview keeps the approved solid readiness donut and readable 100%, completion text and Completed/Pending/Overdue metrics.

physicalIpadAcceptance.name: Backup is one full JSON; restore replaces current data only after explicit confirmation.
Launch transitions smoothly from a substantially enlarged app brand/icon to a substantially enlarged current flag/country/city without flash/blank/jump.
Phrase Helper audio is easy for Kym to follow; “Where’s the toilet?” normal is noticeably slower and Slow is much slower.
Home is a completely still one-screen command centre: no vertical/horizontal document scroll, swipe drift or rubber-band movement on the main canvas at either approved iPad size.
Booked Reservations category icons use Journey History inset icon-tile benchmark with category-specific colours.
Each day can display up to about five entries before overflow indicator; week/day height grows vertically.
Dense reservations remain readable without crushed text.
Journey History map/year filters remain usable and consistent with the shared offline-map and travel-year filtering rules.
Lower analytics widgets use tight deliberate spacing with no large black gaps.
Category icons use Journey History inset icon-tile benchmark with five distinct category colours.
Locked and unlocked Vault preserve the supplied full header artwork in the approved 188px Vault header box; no shared 230px height or crop rule may return.
Unlocked action/status rail stays fully inside header bounds, no bottom cropping.
Privacy/lock status is obvious and no sensitive content leaks while locked.
PIN optional; three-tap/unlock flow behaves as approved.
Attachments/screenshots are understandable and usable offline.
Backup/restore requires explicit replace-data confirmation and is safe.
Sidebar is icon-only in both portrait/upright and landscape iPad modes, with recognisable icons, active-screen highlight and accessible screen names via aria-labels.
Trip Timeline opens only its full forward read-only timeline and does not route to an itinerary editor/detail action.
Accounts manager supports Add/Edit/Delete of manual balances; no transfers or live bank connection exist.
Reservation Health Check is absent from Reservations; App Health remains Settings-only.
Agenda rows show one clear destination/travel colour marker only and Calendar contains no Sync Check panel.
Upcoming and Completed Itinerary rows use calm neutral bodies, restrained identity accents, white normal budget values and amber only for Budget Not Set.
Completed Stays matches the calmer Itinerary readability; Lifetime Travel Spend bars use category colours; Milestones is adequately filled with automatic facts.
Ready to Move uses clear semantic colour meaning and visible progress without dead space or competing purple wash.
Schengen Status appears only on Home; Settings contains App Health, security, backup/restore and app status without duplicate Schengen UI.
Visible adjacent widgets across affected screens do not duplicate the same or near-same colour identity in one viewport.
Normal taps/double-taps never zoom the app canvas; deliberate pinch/spread zoom remains intentional, including map pinch gestures.
Checklist stage strip keeps the approved pre-R13 appearance; all four stage labels and Clear/required text remain fully inside their own tiles with no overlap or clipping in landscape and portrait.
Checklist Overview keeps the approved solid readiness donut; 100%, 16 / 16 COMPLETE and COMPLETED/PENDING/OVERDUE remain readable with no truncation or overlap.
Journey History, Checklist, The Vault and Settings photographic headers each show one distinct cyan widget outline; Settings has no bright baked white top seam.
